objective.name: deepwiki_topics
objective.description: Capacity pilot of the real MCP tests: reads the documentation topics of a public GitHub repository from the public DeepWiki MCP server, through a deterministic call to the outbound gateway, with no inference.

#root.role: Call the tool read_wiki_structure of the registered MCP server deepwiki for the repository the message names, and answer the person with the gateway's account of the call.

transformation_contract.morphing: A message naming a repository and a call_id becomes one MCP call written in advance and a message to the person with its outcome.
invariants: The server, the tool and the shape of the arguments are fixed by this plan; no model chooses them.

The call goes through /root/mcp/client/call with origin plan and the call_id of the message: the gateway admits it only because this plan is listed in the registry, and a repeated message with the same call_id gets the same attempt.
failure: The message gives no repo or no call_id: the gateway refuses the call as invalid and the treatment fails.
